[[File:Galactictouristbureau-ad.jpg|thumb|right|300px]]
The '''Galactic Tourist Bureau''' ('''GTB''') was an organization of travel agencies that include [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]], [[Air Alderaan]], [[Bespin Direct]], [[Dantooine Express]], [[Naboo Spacelines]] and [[Tatooine Transit]]. Each agency maintained spaceliner terminals at [[Spaceport THX1138]] in the months before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Behind the scenes==
This organization was mentioned only in an advertisement on the video screen found exclusively in the queue of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' at [[Tokyo Disneyland]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{C|Tokyo only}}
